page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a printer's ornament band at the top. Below the ornament, a title block: "AD CHRISTIANVM LECTOREM" and "Præfatio." Then the running text in one column, with a large decorative initial at the start. No marginal notes. Show-through from the reverse side is visible in the title area and is not transcribed. No running head, catchword only at the foot right.

main_text.head: AD CHRISTIANVM LECTOREM Præfatio.
main_text.p: DOMINVS NOSTER IESVS CHRISTVS, nihil esse populo Christiano magis noxium, maioreq; studio ac zelo fugiendū, quàm falsos Prophetas, quos Apo-stolus hæreticos appellare solet, gra-uissimis verbis docuit & admonuit. De tyrannis, Iu-dais, aliisq; Ecclesiæ & salutaris doctrinæ hostibus, etiamsi Scriptura ita loquatur, ut eorum insidias nos declinare velit: tamen nihil expressius iubet, quàm ut nobisipsis à Pseudoprophetis & Apostatis attendamus. Cauete vobis, inquit Christus, à falsis Prophetis, qui ad vos accedunt in vestimentis ouium, intrinsecus autem sunt lupi rapaces. Primum autem illud nos observare iubet, Pseudoprophetas videlicet venturos. Deinde non nudè & simpliciter illos nobis fugiendos esse docet, sed etiam eius sua tam necessaria monitionis duplicem adfert causam.Summam eorum qui fugiendi sunt astutiā & dolos: Veniunt ad vos, inquit, in vestimentis ouium; & parem astutiæ ac versutiæ rabiem & ferocitatem, Intus autem sunt lupi rapaces. Ute-nim eos scopulos, dicebat magnus ille Nazianze-

page.notes: Italic and roman boundaries within the text are read from the scan at low resolution and may be imperfect. Long s is written as s throughout. The initial D is a decorative woodcut letter joined to DOMINVS. "Iu-" and "Iudais" with consonant I are rendered Ju-, and "iubet" as jubet, per the spelling rule. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. The ornament band and the ghosted show-through letters in the title area are not transcribed.
